snippet.title: The Guild - Europa 1410 | Showcase 2026 Trailer [OLD]
snippet.description:
The city grows with every passing day, and so can your legacy.

The Guild – Europa 1410 takes you back to the roots of the series, drawing inspiration from the original Europa 1400: The Guild. Build your fortune, rise through society, influence politics, and guide your dynasty through generations. From flourishing markets and growing cities to ambition, rivalry, and power, your story is only the beginning.

Try the free demo and secure your place in history: https://thqn.net/tge-demo-steam
